scripts.build: rimraf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && pnpm run prisma:generate && nest build
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:fast && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:fast:llm: vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/embedding-runtime-config.test.js test/llm.test.js test/llm-answer-stream.test.js test/prompt-manager.test.js
scripts.test:fast:retrieval: vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/indexing.test.js test/vector-store.test.js test/retrieval.test.js test/answering.test.js
scripts.test:fast:assistants: vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/ask-success.test.js test/ask-failures.test.js test/ask-stream-service.test.js test/ask-stream-retrieval-failure.test.js test/ask-stream-controller.test.js
scripts.test:fast:documents: vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/chunking.test.js test/parsing.test.js test/ingestion.orchestrator.test.js test/document-runs-summary.test.js test/external-source-sync.test.js
scripts.test:fast: vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/answering.test.js test/ask-failures.test.js test/ask-stream-controller.test.js test/ask-stream-retrieval-failure.test.js test/ask-stream-service.test.js test/ask-success.test.js test/chunking.test.js test/document-runs-summary.test.js test/external-source-sync.test.js test/fetch-with-retry.test.js test/http-exception-filter.test.js test/ingestion.orchestrator.test.js test/llm-answer-stream.test.js test/llm.test.js test/parsing.test.js test/prompt-manager.test.js test/retrieval.test.js test/traces.service.test.js
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/ensure-build.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/assistants-api.test.js test/retrieval-profile-filters.test.js test/retrieval-profile-strategy.test.js
scripts.test:focus:ask: pnpm run test:fast:assistants && pnpm run test:fast:retrieval
scripts.test:focus:llm-retrieval: pnpm run test:fast:llm && pnpm run test:fast:retrieval
scripts.test:focus:documents: pnpm run test:fast:documents && pnpm run test:fast:infra
scripts.test:focus:sources: pnpm run test:fast:documents && pnpm run test:e2e:sources
scripts.test:focus:api-config: pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:fast:assistants
scripts.test:e2e:chains: node scripts/ensure-build.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/api-flow.test.js test/document-chain-e2e.test.js test/ask-chain-e2e.test.js test/ask-stream-e2e.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:sources: node scripts/ensure-build.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/web-page-source-e2e.test.js test/feed-source-e2e.test.js test/sitemap-source-e2e.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/ensure-build.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/api-flow.test.js test/ask-chain-e2e.test.js test/ask-stream-e2e.test.js test/document-chain-e2e.test.js test/feed-source-e2e.test.js test/sitemap-source-e2e.test.js test/web-page-source-e2e.test.js
